_readme: CareerNexus — central register of external websites.
THIS IS THE FILE TO EDIT when an external destination changes. Add,
remove or correct an entry here and both the frontend and the backend
pick it up; no component hard-codes these URLs any more.
TO ADD A WEBSITE: copy any entry in "websites", give it a new unique
"id", fill in the fields and save. Restart the backend so it re-reads
the file. Nothing else needs changing.
RULES THIS FILE FOLLOWS:
* Official sources only. If an organisation runs its own site, that
is the URL used here — never an aggregator or a third party.
* Never invent a URL. If it cannot be confirmed, it does not go in.
* Every url below returned HTTP 200 when it was added.
SCOPE: this register holds organisation-level destinations (portals,
platforms, career pages, AIIA sections). Deep links that belong to one
specific opportunity — a single notice PDF, one course page — stay
with that opportunity's own record, because they are that record's
data rather than shared configuration.
NOTE ON AIIA LINKS: aiia.gov.in is a single-page application, so its
section links are hash routes (#/coursesAvailable and so on) served by
the same verified domain.
CareerNexus searches this register and its own verified opportunity
records. It does not search the live internet.

meta.verified_how: Each url fetched with a browser user-agent and confirmed to resolve (HTTP 200) before being added.
